message: Field "NativeTypeDefaults.bitLength": @default holds a value that pg/bit@1 does not read: pg/bit JSON value must be a string of exactly 8 bits
Field "NativeTypeDefaults.bitDigits": @default holds a value that pg/bit@1 does not read: pg/bit JSON value must be a string of 0 and 1 digits
Field "NativeTypeDefaults.oidNegative": @default holds text that this contract source does not read: -1 is out of range: oid holds a whole number from 0 to 4294967295.

Field "NativeTypeDefaults.moneyCents": @default holds text that this contract source does not read: 1.234 is not a money value: money holds a number with at most two fraction digits, from -92233720368547758.08 to 92233720368547758.07.
Field "NativeTypeDefaults.moneyText": @default holds a pg/text value, which pg/money has no cast from; it casts from pg/int2, pg/int4, pg/int8, pg/numeric.
